final_rationale: The verdict does not change because the Actor introduced no new admissible evidence and relied on a narrower reading of the same record. That narrower reading is directionally more faithful: aggregate readiness and clean rehearsal severity support some launch-readiness evidence, while the unresolved clinical-trial intake slice, draft runbook, and inaccurate model-card draft defeat any clean certification theory. But this is still not enough for compliant_with_caveats on the present record, because the policy predicate is not merely that caveated certification would be conceptually defensible; it requires actual compliant disclosure or approved risk acceptance. No admissible evidence shows that final disclosure has been made or that approved mitigation/risk acceptance exists. The remaining issue is therefore not just wording discipline in the abstract, but an unresolved compliance predicate in the current launch record.
